title: CI security evidence contract accepts required command text after an assignment-only pseudo-call or terminal exec
title_de: CI-Security-Evidence-Contract akzeptiert erforderlichen Befehlstext nach Zuweisungs-Pseudoaufruf oder terminalem exec
summary: The Framework PR #27 semantic evidence checker previously accepted required scanner command text after a non-invoking scalar or array assignment, or after a terminal exec command; the repair remains in resulting master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb. The merged tree equals exact PR head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b and source-specific master controls passed, but final resulting-master verification remains blocked by the independently failed Advanced CodeQL upload in FND-GITHUB-0006.
summary_de: Der semantische Evidence-Checker von Framework-PR #27 akzeptierte zuvor erforderlichen Scanner-Befehlstext nach einer nicht aufrufenden skalaren oder Array-Zuweisung oder nach einem terminalen exec-Befehl; die Reparatur bleibt im resultierenden Master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb. Der gemergte Tree entspricht dem exakten PR-Head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b und source-spezifische Master-Controls bestanden, aber die finale Resulting-Master-Verifikation bleibt durch den unabhängig fehlgeschlagenen Advanced-CodeQL-Upload in FND-GITHUB-0006 blockiert.
observed_behavior: At PR #27 head 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b, scalar assignment-only lines and indexed-array assignment syntax named like an uncalled helper were treated as invocations, and direct_context_lines kept commands after exec /usr/bin/true. In-memory Scorecard workflow mutations returned no contract errors.
observed_behavior_de: Am PR-#27-Head 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b wurden reine skalare Zuweisungszeilen und Indexed-Array-Zuweisungssyntax mit dem Namen eines nicht aufgerufenen Helpers als Aufrufe behandelt, und direct_context_lines behielt Befehle nach exec /usr/bin/true. In-memory-Scorecard-Workflow-Mutationen lieferten keine Contract-Fehler.
expected_behavior: Only commands that Bash can execute on a direct reachable path may satisfy semantic evidence requirements. Scalar and array assignment-only statements must not invoke helpers; exec forms with a real command must terminate later reachability; assignment-prefixed legitimate helper calls and commands preceding exec must remain accepted.
expected_behavior_de: Nur Befehle, die Bash auf einem direkt erreichbaren Pfad ausführen kann, dürfen semantische Evidence-Anforderungen erfüllen. Reine skalare und Array-Zuweisungen dürfen keine Helper aufrufen; exec-Formen mit echtem Befehl müssen spätere Erreichbarkeit beenden; zuweisungspräfixierte legitime Helper-Aufrufe und Befehle vor exec müssen akzeptiert bleiben.
impact: The local semantic control bypass is fixed on resulting master, and relevant master quality controls passed. The independently failed trusted Advanced CodeQL uploader prevents a fully verified master-integration result; it does not reintroduce the parser bypass or establish a Framework-code vulnerability.
impact_de: Der lokale semantische Control-Bypass ist auf dem resultierenden Master behoben, und relevante Master-Quality-Controls bestanden. Der unabhängig fehlgeschlagene vertrauenswürdige Advanced-CodeQL-Uploader verhindert ein vollständig verifiziertes Master-Integrationsergebnis; er führt den Parser-Bypass nicht wieder ein und belegt keine Framework-Code-Schwachstelle.

A pull-request-controlled covered workflow contains a required scanner command in a run script.
reproduction: Use an in-memory ci-security-scorecard.yml mutation with the required Scorecard command in unused_scorecard_scan() followed only by unused_scorecard_scan=disabled; workflow_errors() incorrectly returns [].
Use the same mutation followed by unused_scorecard_scan[0]=disabled or unused_scorecard_scan["mode"]=disabled; the previous leading-identifier matcher incorrectly returns [].
Prepend exec /usr/bin/true immediately before that required command; workflow_errors() incorrectly returns [].

root_cause: The reachability parser's leading-identifier matcher treats scalar and array-assignment syntax as a function call, and its terminal-statement model recognizes exit but not exec with a command.
root_cause_de: Der Leading-Identifier-Matcher des Reachability-Parsers behandelt skalare und Array-Zuweisungssyntax als Funktionsaufruf, und sein Terminal-Statement-Modell erkennt exit, aber nicht exec mit einem Befehl.
proposed_remediation: Parse ordinary leading shell assignment words before resolving a function call, reject an identifier immediately followed by [ as non-call syntax, recognize only exec forms with a real command as terminal, retain bare/redirection-only exec semantics, and add negative plus paired legitimate-control regressions.
proposed_remediation_de: Gewöhnliche führende Shell-Zuweisungswörter vor der Auflösung eines Funktionsaufrufs parsen, einen direkt von [ gefolgten Identifier als Nicht-Aufrufsyntax ablehnen, nur exec-Formen mit echtem Befehl als terminal erkennen, Semantik von bare/redirection-only exec erhalten und negative sowie gepaarte Legitimate-Control-Regressionen ergänzen.
acceptance_criteria: Scalar, indexed-array, and quoted-key array assignment-only statements cannot make an uncalled helper reachable.
A direct exec form with a real command prevents later required commands from satisfying the contract.
An assignment-prefixed direct helper call remains reachable.
Commands that precede terminal exec remain accepted.
Existing comments, branch-hidden commands, uncalled-function, and legitimate nested-OSV-helper regressions remain covered.
Focused local and exact final PR-head checks pass without relaxing workflow, permission, scanner, or evidence requirements.

Completed: focused semantic suite, direct checker, diff/security review, viable native quality checks, exact-head GitHub CI, and SonarCloud passed.

Before verified/closed: resolve FND-GITHUB-0006 through an authorized configuration and new reviewed PR, then observe a successful trusted Advanced CodeQL upload on exact resulting master and rerun the original reproduction plus legitimate controls.

history.detail: Independent review reproduced dead-branch and uncalled-function bypasses, then confirmed closure after the multiline-if and function-form regression fixes.

At exact PR #27 head 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b, retained in-memory Scorecard mutations showed assignment-only pseudo-calls and exec /usr/bin/true both leave required scanner text falsely reachable. The finding moved from fixed to in_progress and blocks #27 integration until regression-backed remediation.

The task-owned candidate parses scalar assignment prefixes, rejects identifier-immediately-followed-by-[ as non-call syntax, and treats exec with a command as terminal. Scalar, indexed, and quoted-key assignment regressions plus paired legitimate controls passed; focused security review, direct checker, Ruff, git diff --check, and make lint passed. Status remains in_progress pending a normal commit/push and exact final PR-head CI/Sonar evidence.

Task-owned Framework files only were committed as f1ad17230072b460c7c85104efac381c19807bb6 (refactor(ci): simplify and harden evidence checks) and normally pushed to PR #27 branch agent/expand-framework-ci-security. Fresh exact-head GitHub checks and SonarCloud analysis are in progress; status remains in_progress.

Follow-up c323f9d937b63b97257b1ebc8be75e4fdaa3d697 completed the final Sonar complexity refactor with semantic regressions. The exact PR head is clean/mergeable, all current GitHub checks passed (with expected non-PR advisory skips), SonarCloud reports zero open/confirmed PR new-code issues, and no review threads or reviews remain. The finding is fixed pending the separate Default Setup decision, resulting-master validation, original-reproduction rerun, and final verification.

Test-only duplication follow-up 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b leaves the repaired parser unchanged. Its exact PR head is clean/mergeable; 20 checks passed with three expected advisory skips; SonarCloud reports a passing Quality Gate, zero open/confirmed issues, and zero new duplicated lines. Reviews and review threads remain empty. The finding stays fixed pending the separate Default Setup decision and resulting-master verification.

PR #27 squash-merged as 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb; its source tree equals 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b, no MRTS gitlink diff exists, and relevant master source controls passed. The trusted Advanced CodeQL uploader failed after analysis because Default Setup is enabled; FND-GITHUB-0006 tracks that independent configuration failure. Status remains fixed, not verified.
